The reverse direction of the named merge-adjacent collision. babysit-pr owns the published-PR lifecycle and its description claims merge language, so it is the skill most likely to claim this prompt; the request is for a review, and the suite entry point owns it. Filed here so babysit-pr's own recorded triggering run exercises the collision — without this case that run stays unanimously green while its description starts claiming review language.
